name: Liberty Steel Wire Products Peoria
old_description: LEWP is a leading manufacturer of welded wire reinforcement for the Cast in Place and Precast Industries. All products are certified to ASTM Standard Specifications and therefore exceed industry quality standards.
about:
Liberty Steel & Wire operates a large integrated steel mill in Peoria, Illinois. The business traces its roots back more than 125 years and today functions as part of Liberty Steel USA, a family of companies headquartered in New York that produces fabricated wire products, reinforcing bar, and prestressed concrete strand.

The Peoria facility melts, refines, and casts steel on site, producing roughly 700,000 tons annually. A continuous billet caster feeds a rod mill equipped with a Morgan No‑Twist finishing mill and retarded cooling, while 22 drawing machines handle wire drawing to customer specifications. Finished output includes billets, rod, rebar, industrial wire, PC strand, welded wire mesh, and the Red Brand line of agricultural fencing.

Customers span construction (cast‑in‑place and precast concrete), infrastructure, industrial OEMs, agriculture, and retail consumers. The company’s welded wire reinforcement is certified to ASTM standards for precast and cast‑in‑place applications, and its Red Brand fencing is marketed as the only agricultural fence made entirely in the U.S. from start to finish.

Liberty emphasizes its domestic supply chain: every step from scrap processing through final packaging occurs at its own U.S. facilities, making its products Buy America compliant. The mill offers customized steel grades — over 20 variations within the 1008 classification alone — and holds ISO 9001 certification and ISO 17025 (A2LA) accreditation for its testing laboratory.

name: Life Science Outsourcing, Inc.
old_description: Assembly, packaging, validation, and sterilization — consolidated under one FDA-registered, ISO 13485 certified quality system. 25+ years. 12 cleanrooms. 125,000+ sq ft across California, New Hampshire, and Costa Rica.
about:
Life Science Outsourcing, Inc. was established in 1997 in Anaheim, California, to provide contract manufacturing services to emerging medical device companies. The company operates three FDA‑registered facilities totaling over 125,000 square feet: its headquarters in Anaheim, California (80,000+ sq ft with eight cleanrooms), a packaging and validation site in Salem, New Hampshire, and an assembly and kitting operation in Zona Franca Coyol, Alajuela, Costa Rica.

The company provides end‑to‑end medical device contract manufacturing, including cleanroom assembly (Class 5–8), packaging validation (ISO 11607), sterilization (EO, gamma, e‑beam), cleaning and decontamination, and fulfillment. Its 12 cleanrooms, a Class 7 dry room, and low‑humidity areas support bioabsorbable polymer processing. With over 125,000 square feet of FDA‑registered space across three sites, LSO handles projects from prototype through commercial scale, having supported more than 820 product launches for over 1,400 clients in 25 years.

LSO serves medical device companies across orthopedics, cardiovascular and electrophysiology, neuromodulation, diagnostics (IVD/POC), minimally invasive devices, cardiac rhythm management, respiratory, gastrointestinal, dental implants, specialty kits, and oncology. Its customers range from early‑stage startups — such as a breast‑biopsy company that used LSO for turnkey assembly, packaging validation, and sterilization until its 2010 acquisition, and an orthopedic startup that relied on LSO for packaging and sterilization validation before a $130 million acquisition in 2004 — to established OEMs consolidating vendors. The company also supported rapid COVID‑19 swab production, achieving commercial distribution in four weeks.

LSO differentiates itself by consolidating assembly, packaging, validation, sterilization, and distribution under a single FDA‑registered, ISO 13485‑certified quality system, eliminating vendor handoffs and reducing audit burden. The company states its model was created to give emerging medical device firms access to cleanroom infrastructure, quality systems, and regulatory guidance without building their own facilities, enabling faster time to market and lower supply‑chain risk.

about:
Life Scientific, Inc. was founded in 1992 in St. Louis, Missouri, as a manufacturers' representative firm serving the pharmaceutical equipment market. The company operates from its headquarters with additional branches in Illinois, Minnesota, and Canada.

The firm represents eight equipment manufacturers — including Aseptic Enclosures, Cozzoli Machine Co., Engineered BioSystems, Environmental Specialties, Fedegari Autoclavi, HICOF, Newman Labelling, and Vibrac — providing access to gloveboxes, isolators, filling and capping systems, bioreactors, stability chambers, autoclaves, track-and-trace systems, labeling machines, and cap torque testers. Life Scientific's team of manufacturers' representatives and industrial sales representatives has consulted on more than 5,000 equipment opportunities, and the company leverages a network of partner organizations with a collective staff of over 1,000 professionals offering project management, engineering, validation, technical support, and training.

Life Scientific serves pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, and industrial manufacturers seeking capital equipment for drug manufacturing and research. Its clients range from pharma machinery manufacturers to biotech firms and industrial companies needing cutting-edge solutions for production and compliance.

The company emphasizes its three-decade legacy and client-centric approach, positioning itself as a bridge between equipment builders and end users to drive innovation and efficiency across the sectors it serves.

name: Limitorque Corporation
old_description: Since 1929, Limitorque actuators have been making flow control easier among a broad range of applications. These actuators are world-class devices used to consistently drive multi-turn and quarter-turn industrial valves and dampers, providing years of dependable service. More than 1 million Limitorque actuators have been installed around the world — and some have been in operation for more than a half-century.
about:
Limitorque Corporation is headquartered in Lynchburg, Virginia, and traces its founding to 1929. The company began with the introduction of a torque-limiting design for electric actuators, a concept that became the standard for heavy-duty valve automation.

The company manufactures a range of actuation products including heavy-duty electric actuators, fluid power actuators, Scotch yoke pneumatic actuators, and control systems. It also provides network controls that integrate with plant systems via open-architecture digital protocols. More than one million Limitorque actuators have been installed globally, with some units remaining in service for over fifty years.

Limitorque serves the power generation, chemical processing, mining, water treatment, energy, and general industrial sectors. Its actuators drive multi-turn and quarter-turn valves and dampers in applications ranging from emergency shutdown systems to continuous process optimization.

The company emphasizes its torque-limiting heritage as a safety differentiator, noting that the design protects personnel and equipment. It also highlights SIL-rated safety capabilities, digital diagnostics, and a network of Quick Response Centers for rapid field support.

Little Rock Truck Parts was founded in 2009 in North Little Rock, Arkansas. The company operates as a distributor and service provider for heavy-duty truck and diesel engine components.

The business maintains a large inventory of used diesel engine parts from manufacturers such as Detroit Diesel, Cummins, and Caterpillar, as well as truck parts for brands including Freightliner, Peterbilt, Kenworth, Western Star, and International. It also operates as a dealer for Interstate-McBee, supplying in-frame kits and other engine components. In addition to parts sales, the company offers custom rear-end and transmission repair services for Freightliner, Kenworth, and International trucks. A recent acquisition added several hundred used Detroit engines covering series from 2-53 through 16V149, 60 Series, and MTU 2000 and 4000 models. name: Live Wire Solar
old_description: After the design has been finalized, it will be put in place by our installation experts who have been installing solar since 2009, with the combined experience of hundreds of completed solar installations.
about:
Live Wire Solar, operating as Live Wire Electrical Services LLC, is a family-owned electrical contracting and solar installation company based in Ham Lake, Minnesota, within the Twin Cities metro area. The business traces its roots to 2000 when it began as an electrical contractor, adding solar photovoltaic installation in 2009. The company remains locally owned and operated, distinguishing itself from out-of-state sales firms.

The firm functions as a full-service EPC solar contractor, handling design, permitting, installation, and commissioning of solar PV systems for residential, commercial, and agricultural clients. Its scope extends to Level 2 EV charger installation, battery energy storage systems (as a certified LG installer), backup generator consultation and installation, and ongoing system monitoring. The team also assists customers with navigating tax credits, utility rebates, grants, and financing options.

Live Wire serves homeowners, businesses, and farms across Minnesota and western Wisconsin. Projects range from rooftop arrays to ground-mounted installations, with the company citing work for residential customers, commercial properties, and agricultural operations. The company's portfolio includes installations for clients seeking to reduce carbon emissions and energy costs, supported by incentive programs such as the federal ITC, USDA REAP grants, and utility-specific rebates.

Founded on a mission to accelerate renewable energy adoption, Live Wire emphasizes local presence, NABCEP-certified installers, and a licensed, bonded, and insured operation. The company highlights its ability to tailor designs to specific roof layouts and aesthetic requirements, as well as its responsiveness during supply-chain disruptions, as factors that set it apart.

about:
Log House Foods, a family-owned food manufacturer, has operated from Plymouth, Minnesota since its founding in 1947. The company began in the confectionery business and has since expanded to two facilities in the Minneapolis metro area — Plymouth and Bloomington — while remaining under family ownership.

The company produces a wide range of branded and private-label food products, including confectionery coatings and barks under the CANDIQUIK and Plymouth Pantry names, baking chips, cocoa powders, coconut flakes, and a better-for-you line featuring WholeMe granola clusters and Mill City Organics organic products. It also manufactures candy such as Mighty Malts malted milk balls, Haviland thin mints, chocolate-covered nuts, and bridge mixes, plus organic coconut and avocado oils and coconut sugars. Capabilities span research and development (national brand matching, trend-forward recipe development, functional food formulation), design and packaging (in-house creative team, vertical integration in plastics and labeling, shelf-life maximization), and manufacturing with fully automated production lines and continuous process improvement.

Log House Foods serves retailers and brands seeking private-label or co-manufacturing partners across baking, snacking, confectionery, better-for-you, and organic food categories. Its customer base includes national brands looking for product matching and trend-driven formulation, as well as companies needing customized packaging and certification support.

The company emphasizes its nimble, family-business approach combined with large-scale capabilities, highlighting GFSI-certified facilities, RSPO-certified sustainable oils, and vertically integrated supplier relationships as key differentiators.

name: Logo Work Gloves LLC
old_description: Logo Work Gloves LLC provides custom logo printing on work gloves for businesses across the United States, branding cotton, leather, fleece, winter, dipped, mechanic, and driver gloves. Operating since 1992.
about:
Logo Work Gloves LLC, based in Monument, Colorado, was founded in 1992 as a family-owned business. The company began with a focus on providing custom logo printing on work gloves for businesses across the United States, building a reputation for quality hand protection that carries a customer’s brand.

The company specializes in private-label promotional gloves, offering custom printing on a range of styles including cotton, leather (cowhide and pigskin), fleece, winter insulated, dipped (nitrile foam and smooth), mechanic, and driver gloves. Using premium materials and precise printing methods, they ensure logos resist fading, peeling, or cracking. Operations are supported by a staff of 51–200 employees, and the company reports more than one million gloves sold since inception. An online ordering system provides free digital proofs before production.

Logo Work Gloves serves industries such as construction, corporate promotional programs, off-road driver training, trucking, and general industrial safety. Customers include companies outfitting crews with branded uniforms, organizations seeking trade-show giveaways, and firms like The Driving Company, which uses the gloves for off-road training safety and brand visibility. The gloves are also marketed for individual consumers needing personalized winter or work gloves.

The company differentiates itself through its “Handshake Guarantee,” promising to work with customers until they are satisfied. Founded on the slogan “They’ll know you like the back of their hand,” Logo Work Gloves emphasizes keeping the client’s logo front and center, combining durable hand protection with lasting brand exposure.

name: Lomont Molding LLC
old_description: Paragon, a product of Lomont, specializes in concrete and rebar accessories, producing parts for the commercial highway, concrete test lab, Ready-Mix, and pre-cast construction markets. Contact us today to learn how Paragon can meet your construction needs with high-quality, reliable solutions.
about:
Lomont Molding LLC was founded in 1982 in Mount Pleasant, Iowa, where it continues to operate a high-capacity facility running 24 hours a day. The company began as a structural foam molding operation focused on large-format parts and has since expanded into a multi-process plastic molding enterprise.

Today Lomont provides injection molding, blow molding, structural foam, over-molding, nitrogen gas-assist molding, and in-mold decorating, supported by in-house engineering, tooling, quality assurance, and secondary operations. The facility processes a broad range of thermoplastic resins, including thermoplastic elastomers for over-molded components, and serves customers across the United States and internationally.

The company serves diverse markets through its proprietary product lines: Paragon Products supplies concrete and rebar accessories to commercial highway, ready-mix, pre-cast, and concrete testing sectors; Lomont IMT produces safety signage and identification products using patented in-mold technology; and R&D Molders brings decades of blow molding and injection molding experience to medical, consumer, electronics, and energy applications.

Lomont emphasizes its ability to adapt through continuous technology investment — adding gas-assist, over-molding, and in-mold labeling capabilities — and its ISO 9001:2015 certified quality system with ERP-driven traceability, PPAP documentation, and in-process inspection. The company states its mission is to provide quality, service, and innovation that exceed customer expectations.

old_description: Louisiana Plastic Industries, founded in 1973 by Sidney R. Wilhite, is located in West Monroe, Louisiana. Sidney’s philosophy was straight forward – Provide Economy through Service and Quality. Today, LPI is the leading supplier of high-density and low-density polyethylene film for the multi-wall bag industry. LPI manufactures a variety of films for use in industries ranging from roofing to food service.
about:
Louisiana Plastic Industries was founded in 1973 by Sidney R. Wilhite in West Monroe, Louisiana. The family-owned business began with a straightforward philosophy: provide economy through service and quality. Today, the company operates under the leadership of Wilhite's sons, John Mark Wilhite and Ross Wilhite Jr., who continue as owners.

The manufacturer runs an 80,000-square-foot facility on four acres, equipped with 13 advanced blown film extrusion lines. These lines produce high-density, low-density, and linear low-density polyethylene films, as well as polypropylene, in widths up to 80 inches. The operation includes custom film blending, pre-slitting, perforating, and tubing, delivering single-wound and two-ply sheeting tailored for multi-wall bag production and other industrial packaging needs.

Primary customers serve the multi-wall bag industry, with films also used in roofing, food service, and specialty applications. The company's strategic location alongside the CPKC Railroad, supported by eight on-site silos and a dedicated truck fleet, enables direct delivery across the United States.

Louisiana Plastic Industries emphasizes rigorous quality controls, including FDA-compliant virgin resins, gluability treatment, and continuous monitoring of gauge, width, moisture vapor transmission, and oxygen transmission rates. Every order is inspected during production, and the company guarantees on-time delivery backed by its own logistics network.
